task: Integrate reviewed Round 4 Slice A and reconcile the single full make check run against the Round 3 regression ledger.
observation: The full parallel run reported one failure in check_phase21_standard_write_order beyond the 17-job Round 3 ledger. The same test passed on the target base, four direct reruns on the integrated compiler, a filtered isolated-worktree run, and a 43-job Phase 21 parallel group. The cause of the one full-suite-only failure remains unknown.
impact: This required keeping the observed full-suite count distinct from confirmed regressions; it prevents claiming a green make check even though focused reruns did not confirm a new semantic regression.

resolution.summary: The anomaly did not reproduce in the focused direct or isolated parallel reruns. The full suite is not rerun under the one-run integration instruction; retain the exact failure as an unconfirmed anomaly.
